anomalies.observed: The display-power P-channel MOSFET gate (Q3 pin 1, with the 10k pull-up R1 to +3V3) is on the net NET0022. That same net is also the keyboard backlight line LEDK_2_3 (U11 pin 23). SKW92A pin 31 (P4_LED) is the GPIO on this net.
anomalies.expected: The EPD display power-switch gate should be driven by its own dedicated GPIO, separate from the keyboard LED cathode net. The specification says the gate is driven by U5.31 and mentions no keyboard LED connection on that pin.

evidence.quote: NET0022 label on the wire from the Q3 gate node up to SKW92A pin 31 (P4_LED), and U11 BBQ10KBD pin 23 LEDK_2_3 labelled NET0022 (SkylabModule, page 2)
Q2.1 (gate) ... R2.1→R2.2→+3V3 (10 kΩ pull-up, gate defaults high/off), and U5.31 (SKW92A GPIO, datasheet pin 31 = P4_LED/GPIO#39, repurposed here as a general output)

anomalies.impact: Keyboard LED drive and the display power-switch gate would share one GPIO. Toggling the LED or the GPIO can unintentionally switch the EPD power rail, and the 10k pull-up contends with the LED driver, so the display may fail to power up or down correctly.

parsed.summary: The drawing is mostly consistent with the specification (EPD driver parts, FAN53610 regulator wiring, barrel-jack battery-disconnect arrangement and the keyboard matrix all check out), but the display power-switch gate net NET0022 also appears to carry the keyboard LED cathode LEDK_2_3, which the specification does not describe and which would bridge two unrelated functions. Confidence is moderate because the page is dense and the wire-to-pin mapping was read from the drawing.
